name: Bereavement Support Payment
description: If partner died, you are under State Pension age, and they had a NI record. Lump sum plus monthly payments.
eligibility_summary: A lump sum (up to £3,500) plus up to 18 monthly payments (up to £350/month) if your spouse or civil partner died and you are under State Pension age. Must claim within 3 months for full amount.
